issue_context.title: Improve crypto ticks parsing for cases of exchange outages
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
Occasionally, crypto exchanges have downtimes, e.g., [CoinBase](https://status.pro.coinbase.com/history). Our data should reflect unexpected behavior in exchanges graceful.

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
Our ToolBox converter doesn't check for zero or negatives prices; it processes ticks as they come from our data vendor. E.g. there was a 2 hours book downtime in CoinBase on 2019-04-11 [our data](https://www.quantconnect.com/data/file/crypto/gdax/tick/btcusd/20190411_quote.zip/20190411_btcusd_tick_quote.csv) reflected that with -1 values in prices.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10123175/62237725-0a0a0680-b3c1-11e9-92e4-397a1d2a2697.png)

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
Add come logic in our tick parsers to skip ticks with zero or negative values.
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/bfbdace989086b827125461cbdf88f3b18ea6df9/ToolBox/CoinApiDataConverter/CoinApiDataReader.cs#L114

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
Process CoinApi Coinbase raw data for 2019-04-11.

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
Linux
